summary: T733 corrects the cross-module reporting assumption identified after the initial T731 review: positive-fee-only TransferFacts and bounded bids are no longer used to infer free arrivals. The shared pure helper separately counts same-year/currency explicit zero-fee transfer-in events and same-year nonmonetary pool top-ups, labels zero-fee moves without claiming permanent/free-agent metadata, and tests 75 events without bid history. The transfer harness retains the arrival source fields including currency-less events, reads retained event years after close, excludes next-year summer events from the closing year's row, and reports missing legacy observations as unknown. The reviewer reran scripts/lib/transfer-flow.test.ts: 3/3 passed. Simulation pricing/ranking/save behavior is untouched. No blocking finding; T732's separate harness must consume this helper and receive its own review.
